lines.japanese: ん？　ここどこだ？
lines.english: Hm? Where am I?

lines.japanese: 手を動かしてみると、じゃりっとした何かが指先に触れた。これは砂……？
lines.english: When I moved my hand, my fingertips brushed something gritty. Sand...?

lines.japanese: 触覚が目覚めると嗅覚や聴覚にも次々と情報が入ってきた。石灰の匂い、遠くで聞こえる学生たちの声……なんだろう、どこか懐かしいような……。
lines.english: As my sense of touch returned, my nose and ears started reporting in too. The smell of chalk, students' voices in the distance... Something about it all felt strangely familiar...

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: んっ？　いま誰か俺を呼んだか？
lines.english: Hm? Did someone just call me?

lines.japanese: いや、誰かじゃないな。俺の妹は世界にひとりしかいない。
lines.english: No, not just someone. There was only one little sister in the whole world who could call me that.

lines.japanese: というわけで、なぜ目を閉じていたのかは考えずに目を開いてみた。
lines.english: So I opened my eyes and decided not to think too hard about why they'd been closed.

lines.japanese: 夕方……それと体操着？
lines.english: Evening... and a gym uniform?

lines.japanese: 目の前にいる妹は見慣れない格好をしていた。
lines.english: My little sister stood before me in an unfamiliar outfit.

lines.japanese: その向こうには金網。周囲をぐるりと見渡してみれば、記憶の片隅にうっすらこの風景が浮かんできた。
lines.english: Behind her was a chain-link fence. When I looked around, a faint memory of this scenery rose from some distant corner of my mind.

lines.japanese: あれここ、俺と小鳩が通ってた小学校の校庭？
lines.english: Wait. Was this the schoolyard at the elementary school Kobato and I attended?

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん大丈夫？　なんだかいま、ぼーっとしてたみたいだけど」
lines.english: “Are you all right, Big Brother? You looked like you were spacing out just now.”

lines.japanese: 「ぼーっとしてたって言うか、状況がよく分かってない。なんで俺はこんな恰好でこんなトコにいるんだ」
lines.english: “More like I don’t understand what’s happening. Why am I dressed like this, and why am I here?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が目を丸くした。それを見て俺も目を丸くした。
lines.english: Kobato’s eyes widened. Seeing that, mine did too.

lines.japanese: 「だってお兄ちゃんが、私のことここへ連れてきたんだよ」
lines.english: “But you’re the one who brought me here.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんでって……」
lines.english: “Wh-why...?”

lines.japanese: 赤くなった。なんでだろう、俺はなにか間違ったことを口にしたんだろうか。
lines.english: She turned red. Why? Had I said something wrong?

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、どうしたの？　もしかして本当に調子悪いの？」
lines.english: “What’s the matter, Big Brother? Are you actually feeling sick?”

lines.japanese: 「調子」
lines.english: “Sick?”

lines.japanese: 腕をぶんと振りまわしてみる。うん、異常ナシ。頭もぶんと回してみた。やはり異常ナシ。
lines.english: I gave my arms a vigorous swing. Yep, nothing wrong there. I whipped my head around too. Still fine.

lines.japanese: 「平気みたい」
lines.english: “I seem fine.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ、よかった……」
lines.english: “Oh. That’s good...”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、この俺がそう簡単に調子を崩すわけがないだろう。なんたって無敵のお兄ちゃんだからな」
lines.english: “Hahaha! As if I could get sick that easily. Your big brother is invincible, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そかよかった……じゃあ、始めた方がいい？」
lines.english: “R-right, good... Then should we get started?”

lines.japanese: 「うん？　なにか始めるなら早くした方がいいな」
lines.english: “Hm? If we’re starting something, we should start quickly.”

lines.japanese: 何しろ俺は楽しみを我慢できない男。漫画のネタバレをネットで見て、後からがっかりする男なのだ。
lines.english: After all, patience and pleasure don't mix for a man like me. I'm the kind of guy who looks up manga spoilers online, then regrets it afterward.

lines.japanese: 「うん、それじゃ……」
lines.english: “Okay, then...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は髪を耳にかけながら俺の前にしゃがみこんだ。
lines.english: Tucking her hair behind her ear, Kobato crouched before me.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 何故か妹が俺の足の間へうずくまっていた。
lines.english: For some reason, my little sister was kneeling between my legs.

lines.japanese: え、なにこれ。
lines.english: Wait, what was this?

lines.japanese: 「えっと、始めてもいい？」
lines.english: “Um, may I start?”

lines.japanese: 「いや全然」
lines.english: “Absolutely not.”

lines.japanese: 状況は分からないものの、とりあえず罪悪感に苛まされたので首を横に振った。
lines.english: I did not understand the situation, but a pang of guilt made me shake my head anyway.

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だってお兄ちゃんがしてほしいって言ったんだよ」
lines.english: “B-but you said you wanted me to do it, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: なにを？
lines.english: Do what?

lines.japanese: それとも妹が目の前にしゃがみこんだだけで、いかがわしいことを想像した俺がいけないんだろうか。
lines.english: Or was I at fault for imagining something indecent merely because my little sister knelt in front of me?

lines.japanese: でもこの体勢ってどう見ても……。
lines.english: But this position could only mean one thing...

lines.japanese: 「ていうかなんで体操着なんだ」
lines.english: “More importantly, why are you wearing a gym uniform?”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ？　な、なに言ってるの？」
lines.english: “Fweh? Wh-what are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、至極まっとうな疑問だと思うんだ……」
lines.english: “I thought that was an entirely reasonable question...”

lines.japanese: 俺が素で驚いてることに気付いたのか、小鳩は困ったような目で周囲をきょろきょろと見回した。
lines.english: Perhaps realizing that my surprise was genuine, Kobato looked around with troubled eyes.

lines.japanese: 彼女の視線の先を追ってみると、校庭が特別仕様であることに気付かされた。並べられた空のパイプ椅子。校門には大きく「運動会」の文字。
lines.english: Following her gaze, I noticed that the schoolyard had been set up for a special occasion. Empty folding chairs stood in rows, and a large sign over the gate read “Field Day.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いまって運動会？」
lines.english: “Wait, is it field day right now?”

lines.japanese: 「あたりまえだよ。なに言ってるのお兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Of course it is. What are you talking about, Big Brother?”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり頭ぼーっとしてる？」
lines.english: “Are you still feeling out of it?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の言うとおり、俺は頭が呆けてるんだろうか。自分がまともなのか、自信がなくなってきた。
lines.english: Perhaps Kobato was right and my brain really was foggy. I was losing confidence in my own sanity.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんがどうしても二人きりになりたいって言うから……」
lines.english: “You said you absolutely had to get me alone...”

lines.japanese: 「私もお兄ちゃんの活躍見て、すごいねって言いたかったし」
lines.english: “And I wanted to watch you do so well and tell you how amazing you were.”

lines.japanese: よく分からないが、俺は何やら運動会で活躍していたらしい。
lines.english: I wasn't entirely sure what she meant, but apparently I'd been quite the star of field day.

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、体育祭じゃなくて運動会なのか」
lines.english: “Wait, it’s field day, not a high-school sports festival?”

lines.japanese: 目の前の小鳩はどう見ても成長した姿だ。まさか小学生の頃に戻ったってわけじゃないよな。
lines.english: The Kobato in front of me was clearly grown up. Surely we had not gone back to our elementary-school days.

lines.japanese: 「で、今が運動会後ってことは分かった。それで、さっき何かを始めるって言ってたけど、何のことを言ってたんだ」
lines.english: “All right, I understand that field day just ended. But a moment ago, you said we should start something. What did you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ふええっ！？」
lines.english: “Fweeeh?!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は泣きそうな声をあげた。悲鳴に近いような声だった。
lines.english: Kobato cried out in a voice close to tears. It was almost a scream.

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって私ダメだよって言ったよ？　だけどお兄ちゃんがどうしてもって言うから」
lines.english: “B-but I told you we shouldn’t! You’re the one who insisted, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「わた、私、すごくはずかしいのに……」
lines.english: “I-I’m so embarrassed, but...”

lines.japanese: つまり俺は小鳩が合意の上で、彼女が恥ずかしがるような行為をお願いしたと。
lines.english: So I'd asked Kobato to do something embarrassing, and she'd actually agreed.

lines.japanese: 記憶にはないが、どうやらこれは合法の範囲内らしい。ならば小鳩は嫌がってるわけじゃないし、甘えてしまおう。
lines.english: I didn't remember any of it, but apparently everything was aboveboard. And if Kobato wasn't against it, why not let her spoil me?

lines.japanese: 俺は自分を甘やかすことに定評のある男だった。
lines.english: I was, after all, a man with a well-established reputation for indulging himself.

lines.japanese: 「うん、いま自分が置かれている環境はよく分かった」
lines.english: “Yes. I understand the circumstances now.”

lines.japanese: 「えーとそれじゃ……してもらっても、いいのかな」
lines.english: “Um, then... would you mind doing it for me?”

lines.japanese: 「とはいえ、さすがに屋外はまずいだろう。せめて場所を変えよう」
lines.english: “Still, outside is too risky. Let’s at least go somewhere else.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん」
lines.english: “O-okay.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の手を握って避難できそうな建物を探す。
lines.english: I took Kobato’s hand and searched for a building where we could take shelter.

lines.japanese: その場所はすぐに見つかった。俺はふんっと力を込めて、重量のある体育倉庫の扉を開いた。
lines.english: We found one immediately. With a grunt of effort, I pulled open the heavy door to the equipment shed.

lines.japanese: 中は薄暗い。目が慣れるまで少し時間がかかりそうだが、しかしそのおかげで俺たちの羞恥心は薄らいだのかもしれない。一度軽いハグを交わした程度で、すぐ行動へ移った。
lines.english: It was dim inside. Our eyes would take a little time to adjust, but perhaps the darkness also eased our embarrassment. After nothing more than a brief embrace, we moved straight to the act.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんには一度してあげてるもんね」
lines.english: “I have done it for you once before, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は俺のズボンと下着へ指をかけ、下半身を露出させようとする。
lines.english: Kobato hooked her fingers into my pants and underwear and tried to expose my lower body.

lines.japanese: 「は、はれっ？　う、脱げない……」
lines.english: “H-huh? I-I can’t get them off...”

lines.japanese: だが、既に屹立していた俺のモノに引っかかって、なかなか脱がせることができない。
lines.english: But they had caught on my already rigid erection, and she could not pull them down.

lines.japanese: 「お、おかしい、な……あれ？　え、と、あのっ……ごめ、ごめんね、あれっ？」
lines.english: “Th-that’s strange... Huh? Um... I’m sorry. Sorry, wait...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は、上手くいかないからか単に恥ずかしいのか、見て分かるくらいの慌てっぷりだった。そして焦ると余計に手が上手く動かないみたいで、一向に行為が進まない。
lines.english: Whether it was because nothing was working or because she was simply embarrassed, Kobato was visibly flustered. The more she panicked, the clumsier her hands became, and she made no progress at all.

lines.japanese: やむを得ず後ろから脱がそうと、小鳩の手が背中側へ伸びた。だがそっちも、俺が座っているせいで脱がせられない。
lines.english: With no other choice, she reached behind me to pull them off from the back. But because I was sitting on them, that side would not move either.

lines.japanese: 「ふえええ……」
lines.english: “Fweeeh...”

lines.japanese: ああ、かわいいなあ。こんなことで焦ってる小鳩もかわいいなあ。
lines.english: Ah, she was so adorable. Even Kobato panicking over something like this was adorable.

lines.japanese: そんな妹を見ていると心がぽかぽかしてくるのだが、そろそろこっちも、男の子としてのテンションが限界だ。
lines.english: Watching her panic over it made my heart go all warm and fuzzy, but my excitement as a man was about at its limit.

lines.japanese: というわけで、自分で脱ぐことにした。
lines.english: So I decided to take them off myself.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩、ちょっと手ぇ離してて」
lines.english: “Kobato, let go for a moment.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: よっこらせ。俺はちょっぴり腰を上げて隙間を作ると、ズボンをトランクスごと一気にずり下ろした。
lines.english: Heave-ho. I raised my hips just enough to make space, then yanked my pants and boxers down together.

lines.japanese: 「うわっ」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: それは勢いよく飛びだしたせいで、目の前に座っていた小鳩の唇へぶつかった。
lines.english: It sprang out with such force that it struck Kobato, seated before me, on the lips.

lines.japanese: 「あわっ！　あわわわわ！」
lines.english: “Awah! Awawawawa!”

lines.japanese: こ、この愚息めが！　神聖なる小鳩の唇を汚すとは……！
lines.english: Y-you worthless son of mine! How dare you defile Kobato's sacred lips...!

lines.japanese: あ、俺のか。
lines.english: Oh. Right. He was mine.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんこれ、元気いいね……」
lines.english: “This is really lively, Big Brother...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩にまで指摘されてしまった。兄として少し恥ずかしい。
lines.english: Even Kobato pointed it out. As her brother, I was slightly embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「いや、はは……やっぱり期待しちゃってるから、なあ」
lines.english: “Well, haha... I guess I’m getting my hopes up.”

lines.japanese: 「やったねじゃない！　あああ、インパクトの瞬間、メンマの顔を思いうかべちゃったじゃないか……どうせなら、せめて森里君がよかったああああ！」
lines.english: “Don’t give me that! Aaagh, the instant it hit, I pictured Menma’s face... If I had to see someone, I’d rather it was Morisato!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ森里さんに替わる？」
lines.english: “Oh, then should I switch to Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「それなら私はチェンジするね。また現実でねっ、ばいばいお兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “In that case, I’m switching out. See you in reality! Bye-bye, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: あ、これ夢テレビだったんだ……。
lines.english: Oh. This had been dream television...

lines.japanese: なるほどねえ、そうだよねえ。そんな都合いい世界なんてあるわきゃないよねえ。
lines.english: I see. Of course. There was no way a world this convenient could exist.

lines.japanese: 小鳩といちゃつきたいなら、現実で頑張らないといけないんだよねえ。
lines.english: If I wanted to fool around with Kobato, I would have to work for it in reality.

lines.japanese: うっすらと消え行く意識の中、森里君の顔だけがぼんやりと浮かんだ。
lines.english: As my consciousness slowly faded, only Morisato’s face floated dimly before me.
